questions.content: The correct statement about the following disaccharide is :

questions.explanation:
Pyranonse structure is a six-membered heterocyclic ring containing five carbon atoms and one oxygen atom. A glycosidic bond is formed between the hemiacetal group of a saccharide and the hydroxyl group of some organic compound such as an alcohol. C-1 of ring (a) has an -glycosidic linkage.

Ring (b) has 5-members and hence is a furanose.
